en_how: Three G-pen manga artworks processed in Python into 45-degree circular AM screentones with pure vermilion (#F03C1E) kept exclusively for the 7-inch vinyl record and a cream paper-rim halo (白フチ); code builds right-to-left slanted panels opening on the beat, boiling sound effects, a panel-breaking courier leap, a 1-to-16 burst split, a silent resting panel (間), and a colophon end card.
